# Getting help

- **Getting started, modules, layouts and commands:** the [wiki](https://github.com/Eldodeldo/EldoUI/wiki).
- **Something is broken:** open a Bug report. Type `/eui errors` in the game and press **Report** on the error, so the report carries everything needed.
- **An idea or a missing feature:** open a Feature request.

Before reporting, update to the newest release and try with only EldoUI enabled. That tells us whether another addon is involved.
